subject: Daz
fact: Daz has a lot of experience in dealing with leaders suffering from delusions of grandeur, paranoia, and megalomania.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers what the mages said: Lolth became Lolth through betrayal and subterfuge.
source_quote: He remembers what the mages said: Lolth became Lolth through betrayal and subterfuge.

subject: Correlon's consort
fact: It is unclear whether Correlon was Lolth's consort or she was his.
source_quote: Correlon, the chief elvish god, was her consort, or she was his, it’s unclear

subject: Daz
fact: Daz always wondered if the Drow were only on Toril.
source_quote: Daz always wondered if the Drow were only on Toril

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers, or was it a story he heard, of a noble house destroyed by the combined might of the other noble houses because one child survived.
source_quote: Daz remembers, or was it a story he heard, of a noble house destroyed by the combined might of the other noble houses because one child survived.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz understands that societal norms differ, and the Duergar's deviation from Drow norms makes their city more perilous.
source_quote: Daz understands that societal norms differ, and the Duergar's deviation from Drow norms makes their city more perilous.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz knows that Errde wants proof of the Grey Ghosts' alliance with the Council of Savants.
source_quote: She wants proof of the Grey Ghosts' alliance with the Council of Savants.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz knows that Errde does not want evidence that the Empty Scabbard Killers exist, but who has decided her clan members must die.
source_quote: he knows what she wants, not evidence that the Empty Scabbard Killers exist, but who has decided her clan members must die.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has seen that look on many a Drow leader: the desire to kill a group because the leader thinks that is why everything is broken.
source_quote: Daz has seen that look on many a Drow leader. The desire to kill a group of people, because the leader thinks that is why everything is broken.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes the Council of Savants is innocent, or worse, victims of machinations.
source_quote: The Council of Savants is innocent, thinks Daz, or worse, they are victims of the machinations of yet another power.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz laughs at the idea that the Council of Savants has so much control over the Deepking.
source_quote: The idea that they have so much control over the Deepking makes Daz laugh.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is far too comfortable in this nest of scorpions.
source_quote: Zalthir is impressed and worried. Daz seems far too comfortable in this nest of scorpions.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz proposes focusing hatred on the Deepking to make the Duergar slaughter each other.
source_quote: If we can get rid of the Deepking, or focus everyone’s hatred on him, then the Duergar would slaughter each other.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wants to be radically transparent, to say it as it is.
source_quote: He wants to be radically transparent, to say it as it is.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin liked his giant tribe; they didn’t invent complex plots and plans. They were direct and to the point.
source_quote: He liked his giant tribe; they didn’t invent complex plots and plans. They were direct and to the point.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin concludes that because everyone wants to kill them, they are safe.
source_quote: The fact they are all want to kill us, means we are safe.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir was taught the importance of being discreet, of hiding in the shadows, and of avoiding frontal conflict.
source_quote: The monks who taught Zalthir the importance of being discreet, of hiding in the shadows, and of avoiding frontal conflict.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is not entirely comfortable with where this is going.
source_quote: Zalthir is not entirely comfortable with where this is going.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir stares at Errde, and the madness disappears.
source_quote: Zalthir stares at Errde, and the madness disappears.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders why Errde is looking at him.
source_quote: Zalthir wonders why she’s looking at him.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is impressed and worried by Daz's manipulation.
source_quote: Zalthir is impressed and worried. Daz seems far too comfortable in this nest of scorpions.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir walks through the door, overwhelmed by the darkness of his spells and the plots of the Drow and Duergar.
source_quote: Zalthir looks at Daz, Errde, and then walks through the door. A thousand times the darkness of his spells than the plots and fogs of the plots of the Drow and the Duergar.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum has to cross a bridge woven of rothé wool to get to the Shattered Spire.
source_quote: Grygum has to cross a bridge woven of rothé wool to get to it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum picks up the Flumph’s gem and puts it in his bag when no one is looking.
source_quote: When no one is looking, Grygum picks up the Flumph’s gem and puts it in his bag.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notices that Daz has seen something.
source_quote: Grygum can tell that Daz knows something is up, but the Drow is silent.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realizes Werz may have ordered an assassination and is now being targeted in return.
source_quote: Maybe he ordered somebody to assassinate somebody, and now somebody else found out and they have ordered somebody to assassinate him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum suggests using Werz as bait.
source_quote: I suppose we could use you as bait.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum takes note of the timing of the Stone Guards' corruption and the blink of the Faerzress.
source_quote: Grygum takes note of the timing and the blink of the Faerzress but keeps silent.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum admires Daz's cold calculation during the NDA negotiation.
source_quote: Grygum is impressed with Daz's cold calculation

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum yawns while Werz speaks about clan politics.
source_quote: Grygum yawns.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum gives Werz a funny look when Werz says he only cares about getting rid of his assassin's problem.
source_quote: Grygum gives him a funny look

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'And I would like the problem not to be solved with my death.'
source_quote: And I would like the problem not to be solved with my death.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is silent while Thorin speaks to Werz.
source_quote: Grygum is silent.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum listens as Daz explains the concept of a Non-Disclosure Agreement.
source_quote: Daz explains the concept of a Non-Disclosure Agreement

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum tries not to laugh when Thorin says they should tell everyone about their deals with Werz.
source_quote: Grygum tries not to laugh when Thorin explains, 'I don’t like NDAs because they don’t allow for radical transparency and honesty in relations.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum watches as Werz hands over the coins for the NDA.
source_quote: Grygum watches as Werz hands over the coins.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observes Werz whispering about the Stone Guards taking bribes.
source_quote: Werz then whispers to him, 'There are rumors of the Stone Guards taking bribes.'

fact: Grygum notes that Werz claims to care only about trade, not politics.
source_quote: Werz says, 'I only care about gEttin g rid of my assassin's problem.'

source_quote: The Flumph mutters - 'I need more trauma. These dumps are no longer as satisfying.'

subject: The Flumph
fact: The Flumph turns light blue, then green, picks up the gem, then turns magenta and drops it.
source_quote: The Flumph turns light blue. Then , when it turns green, it picks the stone up and plays with it in its tentacles. After a while, it turns magenta, and the stone falls to the ground.

subject: Werz

fact: Werz admits he helped some clans make deals they shouldn’t have.
